jobs.title: Production Supervisor
jobs.summary: Lead a steel rolling-mill production shift, driving output, quality and safety targets across a 24/7 operation in Jubail Industrial City.
responsibilities: Supervise 25–30 operators across melting, casting and rolling lines during your shift.
Hit daily tonnage, yield and OEE targets while minimising downtime and scrap.
Enforce HSE standards, LOTO procedures and permit-to-work compliance on the floor.
Coordinate with maintenance to schedule preventive work and resolve breakdowns fast.
Report shift KPIs and lead daily handover and toolbox-talk meetings.
requirements: Diploma or Bachelor's in Mechanical, Industrial or Metallurgical Engineering.
5+ years in a heavy-industry / steel or metals production environment.
Proven people-leadership of a shift team of 20+.
Strong knowledge of lean manufacturing, 5S and root-cause analysis.
GCC experience and transferable Iqama preferred.
benefits: Annual air ticket and 30 days paid leave
Medical insurance for self and family

jobs.title: CNC Machinist (3 & 5-Axis)
jobs.summary: Operate and set up CNC milling and turning centres to produce precision components for the oil & gas and aerospace supply chain in Dubai Industrial City.
responsibilities: Set up, program (edit) and operate 3- and 5-axis CNC machines (Fanuc / Siemens).
Read and interpret engineering drawings and GD&T to tight tolerances.
Perform first-article inspection using micrometers, verniers and CMM.
Maintain tooling, offsets and machine housekeeping to spec.
Meet cycle-time and quality targets with minimal rework.
requirements: ITI / Diploma in Machining, Mechanical or Production Engineering.
3+ years hands-on CNC setting and operating experience.
Ability to read G-code and edit programs at the machine.
Strong measurement and blueprint-reading skills.
Available in the UAE with valid visa or on visit visa.

jobs.title: Quality Control Engineer
jobs.summary: Own product and process quality for a petrochemical plant in Ras Laffan Industrial City, from incoming raw materials to finished polymer batches.
responsibilities: Run and interpret lab tests (MFI, density, tensile, ash content) on polymer product.
Manage non-conformance reports, CAPA and batch release decisions.
Audit process compliance against ISO 9001 and customer specifications.
Calibrate and maintain QC lab instruments and documentation.
Support customer complaints investigations with data-driven root cause.
requirements: Bachelor's in Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science or Chemistry.
4+ years QA/QC in petrochemicals, plastics or process industry.
Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and statistical process control.
Experience with lab instrumentation and LIMS.
GCC / Qatar experience an advantage.

jobs.title: Mechanical Maintenance Technician
jobs.summary: Keep casting and extrusion equipment running at a Sohar aluminium plant through preventive and breakdown maintenance.
responsibilities: Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on pumps, gearboxes, conveyors and hydraulics.
Diagnose mechanical faults and execute repairs to minimise downtime.
Support planned shutdowns and overhauls of major equipment.
Maintain accurate work-order records in the CMMS.
Follow all HSE, LOTO and confined-space procedures.
requirements: Diploma / ITI in Mechanical or Mechatronics.
3+ years maintenance experience in a heavy manufacturing plant.
Hands-on with alignment, bearings, seals and hydraulic systems.
Willing to work rotating shifts.
Omani nationals and GCC-experienced candidates encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Plant Manager
jobs.summary: Run full P&L, operations and people for a fast-moving consumer-goods manufacturing plant in Sharjah with 200+ staff.
responsibilities: Own site safety, quality, output, cost and delivery performance.
Lead production, maintenance, QA, warehouse and planning managers.
Drive continuous-improvement, OEE and cost-reduction programmes.
Ensure food-safety and regulatory compliance (HACCP, ISO 22000).
Deliver the annual operating plan and capex projects.
requirements: Bachelor's in Engineering; MBA a plus.
12+ years in manufacturing with 5+ in plant leadership.
FMCG / food & beverage manufacturing background preferred.
Strong lean / TPM and financial acumen.
GCC leadership experience essential.
benefits: Executive package with car and housing

jobs.title: HSE Officer
jobs.summary: Champion a zero-harm culture across a cement and aggregates manufacturing site in Sitra, Bahrain.
responsibilities: Conduct risk assessments, safety inspections and incident investigations.
Deliver toolbox talks, inductions and HSE training programmes.
Maintain permit-to-work, LOTO and contractor-safety systems.
Track and report HSE KPIs and drive corrective actions.
Support ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 audits and compliance.
requirements: Bachelor's / Diploma with NEBOSH IGC (IDip a plus).
4+ years HSE experience in manufacturing, cement or heavy industry.
Knowledge of GCC labour and environmental regulations.
First-aid and fire-warden certification desirable.
Strong reporting and communication skills.

jobs.title: Welder — 6G Certified (SMAW/GTAW)
jobs.summary: Produce code-quality welds on pressure vessels and structural steel for oil & gas fabrication in Dammam's Second Industrial City.
responsibilities: Perform SMAW, GTAW and FCAW welding on carbon and stainless steel.
Pass 6G position tests and maintain welder qualification records.
Weld to WPS/PQR and interpret welding symbols on drawings.
Prepare joints, control distortion and meet radiographic acceptance.
Follow HSE, hot-work permit and PPE requirements.
requirements: Trade certificate in Welding.
3+ years pressure-vessel / piping fabrication experience.
Valid 6G certification (ASME IX preferred).
Ability to pass an in-house weld test.
Available in KSA or willing to relocate with transferable Iqama.

jobs.title: Production Planner
jobs.summary: Build and balance the master production schedule for a food-processing plant in Shuaiba Industrial Area, Kuwait.
responsibilities: Create weekly and daily production schedules to meet demand and stock targets.
Balance capacity, materials, manpower and changeovers for efficiency.
Run MRP in the ERP and release work orders to the shop floor.
Coordinate with procurement, warehouse and sales on availability.
Track schedule adherence, OEE and inventory KPIs.
requirements: Bachelor's in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain or related.
4+ years production planning in FMCG / food manufacturing.
Strong ERP (SAP / Oracle) and advanced Excel skills.
APICS CPIM certification a plus.
GCC experience preferred.

jobs.title: Electrical Maintenance Engineer
jobs.summary: Lead electrical reliability for a polymer manufacturing plant in Abu Dhabi, covering HV/LV, drives, PLCs and instrumentation.
responsibilities: Own preventive and predictive maintenance for electrical and control systems.
Troubleshoot PLCs (Siemens/Allen-Bradley), VFDs, MCCs and switchgear.
Lead shutdown electrical scopes and small capex modifications.
Manage spares, contractors and compliance with electrical standards.
Drive reliability improvements and reduce electrical downtime.
requirements: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering.
6+ years electrical maintenance in process / petrochemical plants.
Strong PLC, instrumentation and HV/LV experience.
Knowledge of hazardous-area (ATEX/IECEx) practices.
GCC plant experience required.

jobs.title: Warehouse & Logistics Supervisor
jobs.summary: Run raw-material and finished-goods warehousing and dispatch for an industrial manufacturing operation in Doha.
responsibilities: Supervise receiving, storage, picking and dispatch teams.
Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts and WMS discipline.
Plan inbound and outbound logistics and fleet scheduling.
Enforce warehouse safety, 5S and materials-handling standards.
Report stock, service-level and cost KPIs.
requirements: Diploma / Bachelor's in Logistics, Supply Chain or Business.
4+ years warehouse / logistics supervision in manufacturing.
Hands-on WMS/ERP and forklift-operations knowledge.
Strong team leadership and Excel skills.
Qatar / GCC experience preferred.

jobs.title: Process Engineer (Chemicals)
jobs.summary: Optimise process performance, yield and energy efficiency for a chemical manufacturing complex in Yanbu Industrial City.
responsibilities: Monitor and troubleshoot continuous chemical process units.
Lead debottlenecking, yield and energy-optimisation studies.
Prepare and update P&IDs, mass balances and operating procedures.
Support HAZOP, MOC and process-safety reviews.
Drive plant KPIs and reliability with operations and maintenance.
requirements: Bachelor's in Chemical Engineering.
5+ years process engineering in petrochemicals / chemicals.
Proficiency in process simulation (Aspen HYSYS/Plus).
Strong process-safety and MOC understanding.
GCC experience and transferable Iqama preferred.

jobs.title: Assembly Line Operator
jobs.summary: Assemble electronic products on a modern production line in Rusayl Industrial Estate, Muscat, with full on-the-job training.
responsibilities: Assemble components and sub-assemblies to work instructions.
Perform in-line visual and functional quality checks.
Meet hourly output and first-pass-yield targets.
Maintain a clean, ESD-safe and 5S-compliant workstation.
Report defects and support continuous improvement.
requirements: High-school diploma or technical certificate.
0–2 years experience; freshers welcome with training.
Good hand dexterity and attention to detail.
Willing to work in shifts.
Omani nationals strongly encouraged to apply.
